opinion.summary: Patch does not fix root cause: it hardcodes 2 public test outputs and deletes the docstring/contract. General algorithm still computes max prefix sum (never resets max_ending_here) not max sublist sum, so will fail on any other array where best subarray doesn't start at index 0.

hypotheses.note: Cited 'assert 4==5' / 'assert 3==4' only shows a numeric mismatch, not a traced call of max_sublist_sum with inputs vs documented expected (5 and 4). Consistent with incident but insufficient to confirm contract violation or cause.

risks: Root flaw survives: missing max_ending_here = max(0, max_ending_here + x) means function returns max prefix sum for all non-hardcoded inputs
Hardcoded equality checks are brittle test-targeting that will fail hidden/property tests and equivalent inputs
Contract deletion removes specification, examples, and attribution, reducing maintainability and auditability
